comments.body: DATA LOSS: voiding an invoice deletes the row — the audit trail is gone and finance can never reconstruct it!

comments.author: sarahquigley
comments.body: Void sets `status='void'` and keeps the row; hard deletes are rejected by the table constraint. Walked through the void flow on staging with finance watching — trail intact. Resolving as invalid.
